title: Branch registry
description:
Branch is a first-class dimension of this system, and this repository's branch NAMES carry no reliable information — `Ver1.0.1` is a merged work branch, `Orders` and `Whatsapp` are merged work branches, `ai` and `dev1` are experiments. So classification is declared, never pattern-guessed.

Two fields per branch are computed rather than declared, and both record how: `activity` (from divergence counts) and `base_verified` (from git merge-base). `classification_source` is what makes every value auditable — it says whether a human declared it or a command derived it.

ref.description: The ref actually queried. A local-only branch has no remote ref, and that difference matters when the matrix runs on CI where only origin refs exist.

type.description: DECLARED by a person. Never derived from the name.

base_verified.description: COMPUTED. Whether `git merge-base` agrees with the declared base.

activity.description: COMPUTED from divergence. ACTIVE = has commits the integration branch does not. INACTIVE = fully merged and recent. HISTORICAL = fully merged and no longer worked on. Branches are never deleted by this system.

deploys.description: Which deployment targets this branch feeds, taken from .github/workflows. Evidence for release intelligence, since this repository has no tags.
